name: Priyanka
bio: Mark Suknanan is a Canadian television personality and drag queen. Competing under his drag name, Priyanka, Suknanan participated on the first season of the reality competition series Canada's Drag Race in 2020. He was previously a host of the YTV children's series The Zone and the YTV reality competition series The Next Star, where he went by Mark Suki. His first EP, Taste Test, was released in 2021.

credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.

credits.title: Meet Me Next Christmas
credits.overview: On a quest to reconnect with the man of her dreams, Layla races across New York City to find a ticket to a sold-out Pentatonix Christmas Eve concert.

credits.title: It's All Sunshine and Rainbows
credits.overview: When things go from bad to worse for Melonie Sunshine, she finds herself returning to the family farm and business when her Aunt Tiley passes away. She must find a way to work with her new business partner, Nick Rainbow, and maybe find what true love and hard work really is.
